paragraphs: The GLA250e is the plug-in hybrid variant of the second-generation GLA-Class, introduced with the H247 chassis from 2020. It combines the 1.3-litre M282 four-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor, offering a unique drivetrain that bridges conventional combustion and electric-only driving. As a PHEV, the GLA250e shares its petrol engine architecture with the wider M282 family found in other Mercedes compact models, but with specific hybrid-system integration that requires specialist knowledge when it comes to engine work.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLA250E on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLA250E from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
